== English Tatooine comparison ==
The printed card says “if you just deployed.” The 9 February 2004 supplement uses “Whenever you deploy,” placing the retrieval before the once-per-turn free-deployment clause. The supplement and the 2007 gallery image say “Once per during.” The later 2007 rulebook and 2013 sheet use the same rule with “Once during.” The printed face and early PC gallery image have separate provenance.
